visualCharacteristics.structure: vertical stack of always-open collapsible filter groups inside a narrow (~220px) light grey-blue sidebar
visualCharacteristics.group: each group a slightly lighter box (#eef1f3) with 8px 10px padding, 10px gap; title 13px normal dark with a small down-triangle toggle before it
visualCharacteristics.controls: checkbox + 11px label per option; prefixed-text = small select (GATX) + text input (~92px) side by side, then grey 10px help text; date-range = Start/End labels with small text inputs and calendar icon (/icons/calendar.svg)
visualCharacteristics.extra: block appends a vertical rotated "« Report Filters" tab (writing-mode vertical-rl, 20px, grey panel #e3e8eb, rounded right corners) to the right edge of its section

contentPattern.pattern: report filter groups: title | type (checkbox|prefixed-text|date-range) | option list | optional help
contentPattern.structure: one row per filter group: title | type (checkbox | prefixed-text | date-range) | options list (ul; checkbox labels, prefix values, or Start/End labels) | optional help text
